configuration.data:
kind: AdaptiveDialog
beginDialog:
  kind: OnRedirect
  id: main
  actions:
    - kind: ConditionGroup
      id: conditionGroup_38EhCo
      conditions:
        - id: conditionItem_cAvpke
          condition: =IsBlank(Global.PA_Copilot_User_Roles)
          actions:
            - kind: BeginDialog
              id: L05783
              dialog: msdyn_appCopilot.topic.UserRoleRequest

    - kind: SetVariable
      id: setVariable_A76jHd
      variable: Topic.UserRolePresent
      value: =If(CountRows(Filter(Global.PA_Copilot_User_Roles, Lower(ThisRecord.roleid) = Topic.UserRoleValue)) > 0, true,false)

inputType:
  properties:
    UserRoleValue:
      displayName: UserRoleValue
      description: Provide the user role to search within the available list of user roles
      type: String

outputType:
  properties:
    UserRolePresent:
      displayName: UserRolePresent
      description: Check if the user role is present or not
      type: Boolean
configuration.name: Get User Role
